description: This source file contains the implementation of an immutable Policy class (`ImmutablePolicy`) which models security or configuration policies. It provides methods for creating, modifying, and serializing policy objects, managing entries, subjects, resources, and their permissions.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicy
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Policy interface, representing a security or configuration policy with methods for creation, modification, serialization, and querying of policy entries, subjects, resources, and permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Policy instance with specified ID, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and entries.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutablePolicy object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the optional PolicyId of this policy.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy object to a JSON representation.
